name: Hair braiding and long-hair styling
what_it_is: A collection of hair videos centered on braiding and styling: stylists showing off braided styles (stitch braids, box braids, cornrows, festival braids), a motorized braiding machine demo, a beginner practicing on a mannequin head, and women showing off very long hair being brushed and braided. A few clips are adjacent rather than on-topic, such as a service-bartering post and a purple-hair tutorial.
